position.summary: Chile faced a weather emergency as torrential rains triggered a major mudslide in Las Condes, flooded homes and hospitals, and swept away vehicles. A new right-wing government under José Antonio Kast entered its first real stress test, proposing 2027 budget cuts to social programs including Yo Elijo mi PC and Streets Without Violence. A security reform bill moved through Congress. The Centinela copper mine entered a strike after failed negotiations, and Codelco opened a probe into possibly overstated copper output from 2024 and 2025. Inflation exceeded comfort levels, with the finance minister calling the 3.8 percent annual target challenging. Growth was cut to 0.7 percent and mining production had dropped sharply in August. A diplomatic irritant surrounded diplomat Gabriel Zaliasnik's posting in Israel while listed as an accused party. Mapuche tensions simmered in Araucanía. Labor-market data showed Venezuelans leaving Chile. Chile was named Guest of Honor at the 2027 Frankfurt Book Fair, and the national football team had beaten Mexico two to zero in a recent match.

key_events.event: Torrential rains caused a major mudslide in Las Condes, flooding homes and hospitals in Santiago.
President Kast's government proposed 2027 budget cuts to the Yo Elijo mi PC education program and Streets Without Violence security initiative.
Workers at the Centinela copper mine entered a strike after negotiations with Antofagasta Minerals broke down.
A new constitutional security reform bill entered the Chilean Congress for committee review.
Career diplomats questioned Gabriel Zaliasnik's continued posting in Israel while listed as an accused party.
